t001_title: Axon Trade ApS · The company behind Neural Logic and Hockey24
t002_div: Axon Trade ApS CVR 45 92 07 63 · København
t004_h1: The company behind Neural Logic and Hockey24.
t005_p: Axon Trade ApS is a Danish private limited company in Copenhagen, founded in September 2025 and run by its founder and sole owner. It operates two ventures under their own names. Whatever you sign with either of them, the counterparty is this company: it issues the invoice, holds the data and carries the responsibility.
t006_div: Legal entity · signs, invoices, holds the data Axon Trade ApS Registered in Denmark·CVR 45 92 07 63·one director signs
t007_div: Brand Neural Logic AI colleagues for companies whose knowledge sits in files. neurallogic.dk Online shop Hockey24 Hockey equipment, sold online from Denmark. hockey24.dk
t009_h2: Each name stands for one thing.
t012_p: Builds AI colleagues that read everything a company already holds, lay out the complete file for any case, quote it word for word and state what was not found. Client data is processed in Europe under a data-processing agreement.
t013_p: Neural Logic is a brand, not a separate company. Its contracts, invoices and data-processing agreements carry the name Axon Trade ApS.
t017_p: An online shop for hockey equipment, owned and run by Axon Trade ApS from Denmark. Orders, payments and customer data are handled by this company.
t018_p: Hockey24 trades under its own name. The company behind every order, receipt and return is Axon Trade ApS.
t020_p: If you are checking us out
t022_p: Most people who read this page are about to sign something, or to clear a signature for someone else. This is what they need to know.
t023_li: One legal entity.Contracts, invoices, data-processing agreements and any certificate of insurance name Axon Trade ApS and register number 45 92 07 63. There is no second company behind the brands.
t024_li: A public record.The company is registered with the Danish Business Authority. The register extract is public, and the facts on this page are taken from it.
t025_li: One signature.The company is signed for by its director, Thomas Möller, who founded it and owns it in full.
t026_li: European processing.Client data in Neural Logic work stays in Europe, under a data-processing agreement, with the roles written down before any document is read.
t028_h2: The facts, as the register has them.
t029_p: Taken from the official extract of 1 September 2026. If anything here ever differs from the register, the register wins.
